run.name: AMC Global Media Inc.
run.title: CP-OS host session (AMCX)
run.summary: A refinanced but weakening credit: no debt matures before February 2029, yet earnings fell and the revolver is gone. Free cash flow and cash of USD 464.0 million support it; falling earnings and unseen indenture terms are the risks. Launched through CP-OS as of 2026-11-05 on the retained context.

leverage.basis: Total debt / EBITDA. AOI for the twelve months to June 30, 2026, 313,045 thousand, printed in Rel Jul page:11 and recomputed (C1). Debt principal 1,735,554 thousand; cash 463,996 thousand. Calculated (C3). Same AOI limitation; no credit-agreement ratio exists for this date.

coverage.basis: EBITDA / cash interest. AOI 313,045 thousand over twelve-month cash interest paid 151,153 thousand (C2). Calculated (C4). Quarterly cash interest paid is uneven (Q1 2026 77,983 against 78,984 for the six months, 10-Q Q1-26 page:23 and 10-Q Q2-26 page:27); the twelve-month window smooths this. The 10.50% secured notes carry a higher rate than the debt they replaced, so run-rate cash interest differs (C8).

cash.basis: Cash. Cash from 10-Q Q2-26 page:2. The revolving credit facility was terminated on May 12, 2026 (10-Q Q2-26 page:17), so no committed facility remains in the sources. Cash includes about $136.5 million held by foreign subsidiaries (page:55). An unused receivables sale program with a $125.0 million limit (page:10) is excluded because it is not a committed facility.

gaps: Host session: an agent answered every module from the pinned filings and CP-5 is its own review. No independent review has been made. Treat the analysis as candidate.
CP-2 main limitation: Indentures, ratings, the Netflix contract and any filing after July 30, 2026 are not supplied.
CP-1 main limitation: Latest figures are to June 30, 2026, and the notes' covenant tests are not printed in the sources.
